_emailsync_expected_mx: Expected destination MX hosts (one per line)
_emailsync_quiet_hours: Quiet period without new source messages in hours
_emailsync_monitoring_days: Minimum monitoring after MX cutover in days
_emailsync_runtime_ready: The pure-PHP IMAP transport is available.
_emailsync_runtime_missing: The pure-PHP IMAP transport is unavailable.
_emailsync_runtime_missing_info: PHP streams, OpenSSL or Sodium are missing.
_emailsync_cutover_confirm: Mark the MX cutover as completed now and start the grace period?
_emailsync_reset_cutover_confirm: Really reset the detected MX cutover and its active grace period?
_emailsync_event_initial_complete: The initial synchronization for %domain% completed on %date%. The mailbox will remain monitored until the MX cutover and the subsequent grace period have finished.
_emailsync_event_completed: Synchronization for %domain% completed on %date%. The TTL, minimum monitoring and quiet periods have elapsed; the stored mailbox passwords were deleted.
_emailsync_event_failed: Synchronization for %domain% failed on %date% and will be retried by the next due cron run.
